say: Did you know India has thousands of government schemes, and most people never hear about the ones meant for them?
Meet Yojana+Sahay. A free, independent app that finds the schemes you can actually get.
It opens with live numbers. Over twelve hundred schemes, across thirty four states and union territories, with official links checked, and the last verified time shown right there.
What's happening in your life?
Tap a moment, like a new baby, farming, or a parent turning sixty, and see the schemes that help, step by step.
Family Benefits finds schemes for everyone at home, using the details you share just once.
Or browse by category. Farmers, students, women, seniors, health, housing and more, each with its top benefit amount.
Every state has its own full list, along with the central schemes for all of India.
And popular schemes like P M Kisan and Ayushman Bharat are just one tap away.
Every scheme also has its own page, in English and Hindi, easy to find on Google, with the benefit, documents, and the official link to apply.
Looking for something specific?
Search in English or Hindi, and the right scheme shows up instantly.
The Schemes tab filters by category and state. Open any scheme to see the benefits, who can apply, the documents you need, and how to apply.
Which schemes can you get?
Answer a few simple questions about your work, income, state and family. Yojana+Sahay matches the schemes you qualify for, and explains your results.
Still have a question?
Ask AI Help in English or Hindi. It explains schemes in simple words, and gives you clear next steps.
Got a suspicious message about a scheme? Paste it, and AI Help warns you if it looks like a scam.
Create a free profile once, to save your matched schemes, keep your chat history, and get alerts for new schemes and deadlines.
Switch between Hindi and English anytime, in light or dark mode.
Prefer chatting?
The same eligibility check runs on Telegram. Open Yojana+Sahay bot, tap Start, answer a few quick questions, and get your schemes right in the chat.
How do we keep it accurate?

Every scheme comes from official government sources. Each official page is re-checked automatically, on a schedule. Any change, like a new amount, a broken link, or a deadline, is flagged for review. Our admin team checks and approves it, and the app updates with a fresh last verified date.
Yojana+Sahay is free and independent. It never asks for money or O T P, and always sends you to the official website to apply.
Yojana+Sahay. Find the schemes you deserve. Visit yojana sahay dot vercel dot app, or search Yojana+Sahay bot on Telegram.
